articles.title: 5 takeaways from Broncos' overtime win vs. Seahawks on 'TNF'
articles.summary: Here are five quick takeaways from the Broncos' win over the Seahawks on Thursday night.
articles.body:
The Denver Broncos barely hung on to defeat the Seattle Seahawks in a 17-14 overtime victory on Thursday Night Football last night. Here are five quick takeaways coming out of that ugly win.

1. Denver's defense dominated : The Broncos ' defense carried the team, especially in the second half. Vance Joseph's unit ended the night with 17 quarterback hits, nine pass breakups, five sacks, two interceptions and a forced (and recovered) fumble. Seven different defenders recorded at least a half sack as the unit harassed Seattle quarterback Sam Darnold throughout the contest.

2. Luke Wattenberg's snaps are becoming a serious problem : Wattenberg's snap delivery has been extremely erratic, and if it's not corrected (or if Wattenberg isn't replaced), it will eventually cost the Broncos. One of Wattenberg's bad snaps killed a drive on Thursday. If the trend of bad snaps continues, it could directly lead to a turnover, or even a loss.

3. Broncos' backup cornerbacks stepped up : Pat Surtain ( ankle ) remained sidelined and Riley Moss ( ribs ) was limited, leaving Jahdae Barron and Kris Abrams-Draine to step up once again. Jaxon Smith-Njigba heated up in the fourth quarter, ending the game with 12 receptions for 134 yards, but Denver held him out of the end zone and limited Seattle's offense to just one touchdown overall. KAD secured an interception and slot cornerback Ja'Quan McMillian essentially sealed the win with an overtime interception. The Broncos have incredible depth at cornerback.

4. Bo Nix was bad, and Denver's offense struggled : After taking a 14-3 lead into halftime, the Broncos' offense had six straight punts and then a kneel-down in the second half before OT. Nix completed 17 of his 27 passes (63%) for 107 yards with no scores (and fortunately, no turnovers). Believe it or not, his performance arguably looked worse than those pitiful numbers suggest. Nix appeared afraid to run and made several poor decisions late in the game that nearly cost a win. It seems that the third-year quarterback is either in his head ( perhaps because of his ankle ), or he has significantly regressed. Either option is very concerning for the team's long-term outlook.

5. Broncos have a much-needed mini bye to recover : Jaylen Waddle briefly left the game with a shoulder injury , Tyler Badie injured his thumb and did not return and Jonah Elliss was carted off the field late in the fourth. Surtain and safety Talanoa Hufanga ( ankle ) also remain sidelined. Fortunately, Denver now has a mini bye to potentially help some of those players recover. After playing on TNF , the Broncos will have 10 days until they play again on Oct. 25.

Up next on Denver's schedule is a road game against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 7.

articles.title: Seahawks continue fumbling at an alarming rate in TNF loss
articles.summary: The Seattle Seahawks continued fumbling the football at an alarming rate in their TNF loss to the Denver Broncos.
articles.body:
The Seattle Seahawks lost another nailbiter in Week 6 . They were defeated 17-14 by the Denver Broncos on Thursday Night Football in overtime. For a third consecutive defeat, losing the turnover battle was decisive to Seattle's loss.

The Seahawks have committed a minimum of three turnovers throughout each of their three defeats. They've totaled 10 turnovers in three losses. Quarterback Sam Darnold threw two interceptions versus the Broncos, meaning he's thrown 7 INTs in just four complete games.

Seahawks wide receiver/kick returner Rashid Shaheed lost a fumble against the Broncos. The Seahawks were down 14-3 when Shaheed fumbled an end-around in Broncos territory (30-yard line). It was the perfect microcosm to represent this struggling offense right now.

The Seahawks have lost five fumbles in six games. Granted, they've already played in Week 6, but only two NFL teams enter the weekend having lost more fumbles than the Seahawks have. In total, Brian Fleury's struggling offense has committed 12 turnovers. Only the winless Los Angeles Chargers have more giveaways (13) on offense.

Darnold is now tied for the league-lead with Drake Maye and Justin Herbert in interceptions (7). He's played fewer games than they have. Shaheed, George Holani, Emanuel Wilson, and Jadarian Price have lost fumbles for the Seahawks this season. This offense just can't do anything right.

articles.title: Expert Picks: Longhorns Wire staff predict Texas vs. Florida Gators
articles.summary: The Texas Longhorns try to bounce back after a tough loss in Red River against the Florida Gators. Our staff gives their predictions for the game.
articles.body:
It seems fitting that Halloween is around the corner, because the Texas Longhorns have a lot of demons to exorcise. The Longhorns are coming off one of the programs worst losses in years . And the Florida Gators are a huge reason Texas missed last year's College Football Playoff .

Texas' second half collapse in the Red River Shootout last weekend has reverberated throughout college football. Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning has been a punching bag for the national media and UT haters around the nation. Texas coach Steve Sarkisian hasn't fared much better.

Manning threw two catastrophic fourth quarter interceptions last Saturday against Oklahoma that has made everyone question whether he's even on the right track. And Sark's play-calling has come heavy criticism.

It is almost a carbon copy of the reaction last year after the loss to Florida. If the Longhorns are going to start a redemption tour that sweeps UT into the CFP, the Gators are a good opponent to start against.

Florida set the college football world on fire after upsetting Ole Miss three weeks ago. But back-to-back losses have seen the Gators come crashing back down to earth.

For Texas to keep their CFP hopes alive, this is a pseudo must-win. Florida comes with a dangerous but struggling offenses as of late. The defense is where Texas could earn a major advantage. The Gators defense has struggled mightily all season, especially defending the pass.

This should be a game where Manning and the Texas offense can find a rhythm early and often. I expect Texas to begin making offensive adjustments, slow down Jadan Baugh and get the Longhorns a rather comfortable win this weekend.

I think Texas wins big. The offense will click better than it has all season. Manning will look the best he has all season and the offense puts some points on the board.

Defensively, Texas has another big day. Florida QB Aaron Philo is questionable, as are WRs Vernell Brown III and Bailey Stockton. The Gators will get some yards on the ground with super running back Jadan Baugh. But the passing game will be a mess.

If Texas is (still) a title contender, they need to use this game as a springboard for the rest of the season.

articles.title: El Racing busca en El Sadar romper la racha negativa a domicilio
articles.standfirst: Curiosamente la última victoria del Racing en Primera división fue en El Sadar ante Osasuna el 15 de enero de 2012
articles.summary: Curiosamente la última victoria del Racing en Primera división fue en El Sadar ante Osasuna el 15 de enero de 2012
articles.body: El Racing es junto al Getafe los dos únicos equipos de Primera división que todavía no han puntuado a domicilio. El conjunto cántabro sería el colista de una hipotética clasificación fuera de casa. El Racing ha perdido ante Getafe, Rayo Vallecano, Barcelona y Celta. en estos dos últimos encuentros el conjunto santaderino además fue goleado. Los hombres de José Alberto tienen cero puntos, 4 goles a favor y la friolera de 16 tantos en contra. Curiosamente la última victoria del Racing en Primera división fue en El Sadar ante Osasuna el 15 de enero de 2012, En aquella ocasión los cantabros vencieron 0-2 con doblete de Stuani. El Racing descendió esa temporada y no ha retornado a la máxima categoría hasta esta pasada campaña. En segunda división se enfrentaron en la campaña 2014-15 con también victoria del conjunto cántabro 0-2, en aquella ocasión el goleador por partida doble fue Juampe. José Alberto tiene el secreto para poder romper la racha negativa a domicilio, ' Tenemos que ser valientes, no cometer errores, jugar hacia delante, tener personalidad y carácter con balón' .Para este choque el técnico asturiano podrá contar con toda la plantilla excepto Eriksson que continúa recuperándose de su lesión de hombro.

articles.title: Barcelona face staff strike ahead of El Clasico as Camp Nou workers demand pay rise and more employees
articles.summary: Barcelona are facing a potential disruption to operations surrounding the Clasico against Real Madrid on October 25, with a group representing the club’s per...
articles.body:
Barcelona are facing a potential disruption to operations surrounding the Clasico against Real Madrid on October 25, with a group representing the club's permanent seasonal workers announcing a three-day strike over what they describe as deteriorating working conditions.

According to SPORT , the industrial action will begin at midnight on October 23 and continue until 06:00 on October 26, covering the period of one of the biggest fixtures on Barcelona's calendar.

The workers cite staff shortages, alleged contractual irregularities and a lack of concrete commitments from the club among their main grievances.

Barcelona, however, insist that the strike will not jeopardise the staging of the Clasico or other sporting events scheduled during the period.

Why Barcelona's seasonal workers are striking

The strike committee has accused the club of allowing working conditions to deteriorate, pointing to "the failure to honour agreements, contractual irregularities, and instances of discrimination between male and female staff at the same club."

The group has also raised concerns about services being outsourced to external companies, arguing that the situation is affecting the quality of services provided to members and supporters.

Barcelona are facing workers' strike ahead of El Clasico. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images)

"We warn that this situation is undermining service standards, reducing the ability to respond to incidents and harming the service provided to members and supporters.

"We consider this industrial action to be a last resort in the face of a lack of progress and concrete commitments," the strike committee said in a statement.

The workers are demanding a pay rise and a 50% increase in their numbers, which would take the workforce from approximately 60 to 90 employees.

Clasico is among several Barcelona events affected

The industrial action will extend beyond the men's first-team meeting with Real Madrid at Spotify Camp Nou.

According to SPORT, it will also affect all facilities where the workers carry out their duties, including the Johan Cruyff Stadium, the Palau Blaugrana and the Joan Gamper Training Centre.

Consequently, Barcelona's women's first-team matches, basketball and handball fixtures, and youth-team activities could also be affected during the strike period.

Barcelona have a decision to make (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images)

As such, the Clasico is expected to face particular operational pressure because of the scale of the event.

Barcelona estimate that a match of this magnitude involves around 80,000 people, including spectators and security personnel deployed around the stadium.

Barcelona insist Real Madrid match will go ahead

Despite the workers' concerns, Barcelona maintain that they have sufficient organisational capacity to manage any potential incidents and ensure that matches proceed normally.

The club has also emphasised that the group consists of around 60 permanent seasonal workers operating under their own collective agreement, with pay conditions that it says exceed the sector's usual standards.

Barcelona insist they respect the employees' demands and will continue negotiations.

However, with the strike scheduled to overlap with the Real Madrid fixture, the outcome of those discussions will be important in determining how the club manages operations throughout the busy period.

articles.title: El Real Madrid exige la "dimisión inmediata de Javier Tebas" como presidente de LaLiga
articles.standfirst: Duro y extenso comunicado del club blanco tras las declaraciones de Tebas en las que comparaba la comunicación del Real Madrid con la de Goebbels
articles.summary: Duro y extenso comunicado del club blanco tras las declaraciones de Tebas en las que comparaba la comunicación del Real Madrid con la de Goebbels
articles.body: El Real Madrid ha exigido en un comunicado la dimisión de Javier Tebas, el presidente de LaLiga, tras sus declaraciones en redes sociales en las que compara la comunicación del club blanco con los métodos de Goebbels, ministro de Propaganda Nazi. El Real Madrid lamenta en su escrito el "nuevo ataque" del presidente de LaLiga, algo que considera inadmisible por el cargo que ostenta. "Ante las manifestaciones de Javier Tebas, presidente de LaLiga y vicepresidente de la Real Federación Española de Fútbol, en las que compara los métodos de actuación de la dirección del Real Madrid con los utilizados por Joseph Goebbels, ministro de Propaganda del régimen nazi, señalando a Real Madrid Televisión como instrumento de esa supuesta estrategia, el Real Madrid C. F. manifiesta lo siguiente: 1. El Real Madrid C. F. considera absolutamente intolerable y de extraordinaria gravedad que quien ocupa dos cargos de máxima responsabilidad en el fútbol español recurra a una comparación con los métodos de propaganda del régimen nazi para desacreditar a nuestro club, a su dirección y a su televisión. La aclaración de que no se refiere a la ideología nazi no atenúa el carácter profundamente ofensivo, moralmente repugnante e institucionalmente indigno de sus manifestaciones. 2. Estas declaraciones constituyen un nuevo episodio de los ataques reiterados de Javier Tebas contra el Real Madrid, su presidente y sus medios de comunicación. Resulta inadmisible que aproveche incluso preguntas, informaciones u opiniones de periodistas ajenos al club para dirigir contra nosotros sus descalificaciones, atribuyéndonos actuaciones de terceros sobre las que no tenemos responsabilidad alguna. 3. Resulta especialmente grave que Tebas utilice estas manifestaciones para cuestionar las legítimas actuaciones del Real Madrid y de Real Madrid Televisión en relación con el caso Negreira. Ante la falta de una respuesta a la extraordinaria gravedad del caso Negreira por parte de las dos instituciones en las que Javier Tebas ostenta responsabilidades de máxima relevancia, nuestro club ha tenido que acudir directamente a UEFA para exigir el completo esclarecimiento de los pagos realizados durante años por el F. C. Barcelona al vicepresidente del Comité Técnico de Árbitros y la adopción de las medidas necesarias para garantizar la integridad de las competiciones. El Real Madrid exige asimismo una renovación integral del sistema arbitral y de las estructuras federativas de gobierno, gestión, supervisión y disciplina, mediante la renovación de quienes desempeñaron funciones de responsabilidad durante aquella etapa. Resulta especialmente significativo que Javier Tebas, presidente de LaLiga y vicepresidente de la Real Federación Española de Fútbol, organización en la que se integra el Comité Técnico de Árbitros, dedique sus esfuerzos a desacreditar al Real Madrid en lugar de impulsar, desde sus responsabilidades institucionales, el esclarecimiento de estos gravísimos hechos y la necesaria regeneración del fútbol español. 4. La conducta reiterada de Javier Tebas evidencia una falta de neutralidad, respeto e imparcialidad incompatible con sus responsabilidades institucionales. Sus ataques constantes al Real Madrid y a quienes reclaman transparencia y regeneración constituyen, a juicio de nuestro club, una auténtica lacra para el fútbol español. 5. Por todo ello, el Real Madrid C. F. considera que las manifestaciones y comportamientos reiterados de Javier Tebas resultarían inadmisibles en cualquier institución deportiva europea que se rija por principios de respeto, neutralidad e integridad, y que lo descalifican institucionalmente para continuar desempeñando los cargos que ocupa. En consecuencia, el Real Madrid C. F. exige su dimisión inmediata como presidente de LaLiga y vicepresidente de la Real Federación Española de Fútbol. El Real Madrid C. F. continuará defendiendo sus derechos, su prestigio institucional, el completo esclarecimiento del caso Negreira y la necesaria regeneración del fútbol español".

articles.title: Enzo Maresca reveals Pep Guardiola meeting after Man City defeat to PSG: ‘It’ll always be his house’
articles.summary: The Premier League leaders aim to bounce back after a blow in the Champions League at the hands of Paris Saint-Germain, with Maresca sharing his views on the...
articles.body:
Enzo Maresca has revealed how he met Pep Guardiola following Manchester City 's defeat to Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League midweek.

The City boss met with his predecessor at the Etihad Stadium after the game, with Guardiola present to show support following the bombshell guilty verdict from the independent commission on the 115 charges.

But the Italian has shared how Guardiola met him following the setback at the hands of the two-time defending European champions.

"I saw him after the game," Maresca said. "Not before, we were talking about the game, the first half, the second half, he was very happy to be at the stadium.

"Very positive about things he's seen in the game. It was great for the fans to see him at the stadium. It'll always be his house."

Maresca is also content with how the club has handled the damaging news in recent weeks and added that his trust towards the club remains at "100 per cent".

"We handled it quite good, the fans, the team, everyone, tomorrow is three points game, the same as Anfield away, it's important to continue the run and try to win," Maresca added.

"I'm very happy, I said many times, I don't feel any kind of stress about the outside situation, it's something I don't control. I focus on how to win the next games.

"It's very dangerous, they have the whole week to prepare. It'll be very tough, for us it's important, a great opportunity to win and go six points clear.

"I'm quite respectful person, everyone can say what they want and agree with what they want. From my point of view, the wise way is to wait for the final word. People want to speak about this situation. I completely trust the club, I don't need people outside of the club to understand the situation. It's very clear, I trust the club, 100 per cent.

During City's 3-0 win at Liverpool last week, fans in the away section of Anfield celebrated with blow-up bananas in a nod to the club's past in the lower divisions, with Maresca keen to experience the gesture once more against Ipswich at the weekend.

"It was very nice," Maresca admitted. "I didn't know the history about the bananas, I hope to see many bananas in the stadium.

"It creates a nice envuroin for the fans and everyone in the stadium. I have four kids, they already asked me, tomorrow they will be in the stadium and ask me.
